THE APPLICATION — one Hetzner CPX31, every request through proxy.ts
kamal-proxy v0.9.2 — TLS termination · automatic certificates · health check /api/health every 5s · --buffer-requests --buffer-responses
Keeps 5 old containers — that is the practical rollback window. ⚠ Logs rotate at 10 MB and are shipped nowhere.
proxy.ts — the gate (Next 16's renamed middleware). Both lists match on a / boundary, so /api/health-summary does NOT match the public /api/health.
ADMIN_PREFIXES (API only, NOT /admin/* pages): /api/admin · /api/shopify/sync ⚠ /api/shopify/orders was here until 2026-09-16; that route is deleted
DEPLOY: commit → `kamal deploy` ON THE BOX builds the image with 15 build secrets → pushes to GHCR → pulls it back → health check → swap.
⚠ .kamal/secrets is a LOADER, tracked in git and holding NO values: each line greps one value out of .env.kamal, which is gitignored.
Routes, pages, shared modules and every stage gate → OMS-STATE. Auth, credentials and what expires → OPERATIONS §5.
DATA — Supabase: Postgres + RLS + Realtime + Storage
projects → orders. A checkout is a PROJECT; its lines split by vendor into one `orders` row per CATEGORY. Money, ownership, payment status and archiving live on the PROJECT.
⚠ The model is the thing this map used to get wrong. It lives in OMS-STATE §2–§3 and is not redrawn here.
order_activity (append-only) · order_attachments (general | proof_of_delivery) · order_acknowledgments (+ lines_fingerprint) · damage_reports · claim_submissions
sku_mappings · team_members (password_hash SELECT revoked) · vendors · shopify_products · webhook_events · audit_log
CHECK constraints on orders, each tying one fact to one place: total_price, the three payment fields and archived are STANDALONE-ONLY (null or false on a project-linked row).
archived_at matches archived, on orders AND projects: archived exactly when dated. Added 2026-09-16 — see OMS-STATE §3 for what they enforce and why.
⚠ Accepted risk: qual=true SELECT on orders / team_members for authenticated — required by Realtime. Service-role writes only.

FLOWS THAT CROSS A SYSTEM BOUNDARY
Shopify order → /api/shopify/webhook (HMAC) → split by line-item vendor → one project + one orders row per category. payment_status is written to the PROJECT only.
Manufacturer .xlsx acknowledgment → /api/orders/[id]/acknowledgment → reconciled against the order's decoded lines.
⚠ A green acknowledgment stores a FINGERPRINT of what it matched. If the order changes afterwards the green is stale, and the modal says so.
Tracking number → "Shipped", by EITHER door: typed in the modal, or carried on a Shopify fulfilment. Samples buy their label in Shopify, so there the fulfilment is the primary door.
Stage change → shopifyStageSync → Production Stage note + merged tags. Custom jobs never sync. Only the group holding shopify_id can be written back.
Any orders write → Supabase Realtime → the store → every page. ⚠ A realtime payload carries the row, not the join, so the store resolves project facts itself.
Each cron run → its script validates the ping URL, then pings healthchecks.io. ⚠ The job's exit status is untouched by ping failures: monitoring must never break the thing it monitors.
Customer → /api/public/lookup and /api/public/claims. Stage names are translated by lib/customerFacing before they leave; claim types are values, never words a customer reads.
Notifications: Graph is configured and scoped, and NOTHING SENDS. ⚠ The order confirmation already promises updates the OMS does not send.
WHERE THE FACTS LIVE — this map is not one of them
The document split lives in OPERATIONS, in the header block above §1, and ONLY there.
Restating it here would make this the fourth copy — and a four-row summary of a six-row table is how the last one went wrong.
⚠ This map draws external services, the box, and flows that cross a system boundary. Nothing that answers "how does the work move" belongs here.
Redrawn 2026-09-22 from scratch: the 2026-08-27 version had been amended until its boxes no longer fitted their text.
